Leah: Quick: customer asks for tenant-gated rollout with EU holdback, per-tenant opt-in, canary windows, A/B checks, and instant kill-switch. Need capacity and SLO owners.

Mason: I can own capacity. Proposal: tenant slices by region: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 48h if stable. Reserve 10% Dedicated capacity for premium tenants.

Priya: Runtime: region+tenant slices makes sense. Add KV-prefix warm for canary tenants and a schema contract smoke. Also recommend shadowing before A/B.

Leah: Launch gates: zero P0s for 24h, p99 latency <400ms for canaries, quality regressions <2% on evals, legal sign-off for EU routing.

Mason: Need an operational kill-switch that flips tenant override to a quantized fallback model and reroutes traffic. We have /flags/kill endpoint; ensure per-tenant soft-redirect.

Priya: Add telemetry: per-tenant latency, cost delta, and quality delta in Console. Also add quota caps per tenant and alert at 80%.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for feature flag "tenant-gate-2025" at 2025-07-16T08:00Z.

Leah: Action items: (1) Mason: reserve capacity and update plan, (2) Priya: add schema smoke + KV warm step, (3) Ops: draft rollback runbook and post in #eng-oncall by EOD, (4) Legal: confirm EU VPC pin. I'll confirm percentages with customer.

Mason: +1

Priya: +1

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary blocked until runbook and capacity reservation complete.
